segments.snp5.8:1.4: Ñāṇūpapannaṃ no muniṃ [muni no (syā. ka.)] vadanti, udāhu ve jīvitenūpapannaṃ”.
segments.snp5.8:2.1: “Na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena,(na sīlabbatena)[() natthi sī. -pī potthakesu]
segments.snp5.8:2.3: Visenikatvā anīghā nirāsā, caranti ye te munayoti brūmi”.
segments.snp5.8:3.3: Diṭṭhassutenāpi [diṭṭhena sutenāpi (sī.), diṭṭhe sutenāpi (syā. pī. ka.)] vadanti suddhiṃ;
segments.snp5.8:3.4: Sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ;
segments.snp5.8:3.6: Kaccissu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñca jarañca mārisa;
segments.snp5.8:3.8: Pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ”.
segments.snp5.8:4.4: Sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ;
segments.snp5.8:4.6: Kiñcāpi te tattha yatā caranti, nāriṃsu jātijaranti brūmi”.
segments.snp5.8:5.4: Sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ;
segments.snp5.8:5.6: Te ce muni [sace muni (sī.)] brūsi anoghatiṇṇe, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke;
segments.snp5.8:5.8: Atāri jātiñca jarañca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ”.
segments.snp5.8:6.4: Ye sīdha diṭṭhaṃva sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vāpi pahāya sabbaṃ;
segments.snp5.8:6.6: Anekarūpampi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse;
segments.snp5.8:7.3: Ye sīdha diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vāpi pahāya sabbaṃ;
segments.snp5.8:7.5: Anekarūpampi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse;

lines: Tattha paṭhamagāthāya attho – loke khattiyādayo janā ājīvakanigaṇṭhādike sandhāya “santi munayo”ti vadanti, tayidaṃ kathaṃsūti kiṃ nu kho te samāpattiñāṇādinā ñāṇena uppannattā ñāṇūpapannaṃ no muniṃ vadanti, evaṃvidhaṃ nu vadanti, udāhu ve nānappakārakena lūkhajīvitasaṅkhātena jīvitenūpapannanti athassa bhagavā tadubhayaṃ paṭikkhipitvā muniṃ dassento “na diṭṭhiyā”ti gāthamāha.
1086-7. Idāni “diṭṭhādīhi suddhī”ti vadantānaṃ vāde kaṅkhāpahānatthaṃ “ye kecime”ti pucchati.
Tattha yatā carantāti tattha sakāya diṭṭhiyā guttā viharantā.
Athassa tathā suddhiabhāvaṃ dīpento bhagavā dutiyaṃ gāthamāha.
1088-90. Evaṃ “nātariṃsū”ti sutvā idāni yo atari, taṃ sotukāmo “ye kecime”ti pucchati.
Athassa bhagavā oghatiṇṇamukhena jātijarātiṇṇe dassento tatiyaṃ gāthamāha.
